properties.name: Two wrong-in-the-reassuring-direction reports fixed: a snapshot warning that was false and prescribed a corrupting undo, and a durability aid that was written, tested and filtered out of everything served
properties.rationale: Both came from the dev_storyflow reflow2_feedback.md read of 2026-08-23 (411 new lines since the 2026-08-16 triage at 6,203). Both were reported by a session that DISBELIEVED a reassuring answer and checked — one read the snapshot back by hand, the other re-exported as a control and got `wrote: changed` against a green verdict. Neither would have surfaced from inside.
properties.subject: system
properties.summary: `prior_state_coverage` replaces a whole-node snapshot test with a field-aware one, so a revising write stops claiming "no snapshot holds the state it replaced" about a value the snapshot holds verbatim. And `loop_status` now surfaces the unexported-work sentence in `next` — it already existed on the in-step line and was filtered out because `in_step` is not `is_actionable()`.
